Invoking against 3 real prod cases (TC-838571, TC-838570, TC-838569) each returned 200 with the correct case in the data.test_case envelope, ~47 real fields, no `title` key, and the true field `name` populated ("MCP", "MCP", "User Register form"). notes:
Full reproduction of the preprod DRIFT verdict on production, using real project 332537 (PR-18723), folder 9697326 ('MCP Testing'), across all 3 available fixture cases (TC-838571 id 32747791, TC-838570 id 32747562, TC-838569 id 32747539). Contract: describeCapability returned an identical declared-200 schema to preprod — 3 properties (identifier, id, title) under data.test_case, no test_case_steps entry, no json_path field on the tool output itself (recorded here as data.test_case per the envelope guidance and observed response shape). Function: PASS — each invoke returned 200 with the exact requested case (ids and identifiers matched 1:1), inside a flat {success, test_case} envelope under data, as declared. Schema-vs-reality: DRIFT, reproducing preprod precisely — `title` is declared but does not exist in any of the 3 real payloads; the real title field is `name`. ~44-47 undeclared fields returned beyond the 3 declared ones (count varies slightly by case due to custom_fields population and reviewers/review_status presence). case_type/priority/status/automation_state all carry a populated `field_name` (category/priority/status/automation_state respectively) on every one of the 3 prod cases, confirming preprod's field_name-present finding holds on prod. test_case_steps is undeclared (not merely mis-typed) and is an empty array at runtime on all 3 samples, consistent with preprod; the sibling `steps` field is likewise an empty array on all 3, but since every available fixture case uses the plain-text template (not a step-based template), whether steps/test_case_steps would be non-empty on a step-based case is UNVERIFIED — no such case was present in the given folder to test against.

Additional minor observation not present in the preprod trace: this prod response includes `reviewers` (empty array) and `review_status` ("pending") fields that the preprod item_shape did not record at all, and has updator_details/updated_at/preconditions populated (non-null) where the preprod sample had them null/empty — differences attributable to per-case field population (this case has actually been updated/reviewed) rather than any environment-level schema difference. These do not change the verdict; they're additional undeclared fields on the same already-massively-undeclared payload.
